_comment: Documentation example only. Exactly one optional Player Character object may exist across addon files.

_field_help.character: Updates the existing Player Character; it never creates a second player.
_field_help.conditions: Current short-lived conditions supplied to narration.
_field_help.meters: Simple labeled current/max counters such as health, stress, or mana.

character.name: Evelyn Harcourt
character.summary: The sole heir of House Harcourt, investigating a dangerous succession conspiracy.
character.details: Private character notes that should not be injected by default.
character.appearance: Dark formal attire, practical boots, and a concealed signet ring.
character.personality: Observant, stubborn, and careful with trust.
character.goals: Find the witness and secure her claim without exposing allies.
character.voiceNotes: Controlled diction with flashes of dry humor.

meters.label: Stress
meters.notes: Rises when court scrutiny closes in.
